'''Gwori''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Clacis sector/Legends|Clacis sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].

==History==
Gwori was home to [[Gwori Revolutionary Industries/Legends|Gwori Revolutionary Industries]] and was the site of one of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|CIS's]] biggest [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyards]]. Early in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Gwori's shipyard was infiltrated by [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] forces on a [[Battle of Gwori|mission]] to destroy it.<ref name="SoD" /> The mission marked one of the first deployments of the [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL Y-wing starfighter]].<ref name="DB">{{DB|starship|ywingstarfighter|Y-wing starfighter}}</ref>

During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]], the planet's shipyards were seized by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in order to exclusively produce [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers]].<ref name="TEGtW" />
